race.comment: THE MAGIC MAN (4) burnt turf in front and kept going for an authoritative win last start over this distance at Muswellbrook. Tackles a better race today but drops 2.5kgs and from a lovely draw he should be in the firing line for a long way again. SONG FOR ROSIE (7) returned from a seven-month spell with a tough win last time out over today's journey at Muswellbrook. Ran a fraction quicker than THE MAGIC MAN on the same card. Eligible for easier races but she is back in great shape and can get the job done again. PRATT (1) was very good two back in open company over this distance at Taree. Led for home in a Randwick Highway more recently and wilted. Key runner back in this more suitable assignment. SINGING STAR (8) returned in good order last start and is rarely far away.
